description: Validate and format a phone number with Google's libphonenumber metadata: valid/possible for its region, E.164, international and national formats, tel: URI, country, and line type (MOBILE, FIXED_LINE, TOLL_FREE, VOIP, …). Pass defaultCountry for numbers written without a +country code. Offline metadata check — it does not dial or confirm the line is in service. Companion to email_address_validate.

defaultCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country to assume when the number has no + prefix, e.g. US, GB, DE

phone.description: Phone number in any common format, e.g. +1 650-253-0000 or (650) 253-0000

name: phone_validate
